knight-padded: Use case: stylized-concept. Production RPG character animation sprite sheet, polished hand-painted fantasy chibi with expressive face, detailed gold-trim clothing, fine dark outlines, jewel highlights, 3/4 front game view. TRANSPARENT background. Exactly 12 isolated full-body sprites on an invisible perfectly uniform FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW grid, no visible lines, no text. Canvas landscape 4:3, equal square cells, generous empty padding in every cell. Same identity and outfit all 12 sprites, consistent scale, feet baseline near 80% cell height. All weapons fully inside their own cell. Row 1 precisely four walking frames: left step, passing, right step, passing. Row 2 precisely four attack frames: anticipation, windup, release/impact, recovery. Row 3 precisely four death frames: stagger upright, kneeling, falling sideways, fully collapsed on ground. No blood. All frames face toward viewer-right. Male blue-and-silver sword knight, tousled brown hair, blue tabard and cape, silver plate armor gold trim, long silver sword and blue heraldic shield. Attack swinging sword. CRITICAL SPATIAL REQUIREMENT: each character ONLY occupies the CENTER 60% width and 65% height of its square cell. 20% blank transparent border on LEFT AND RIGHT of EVERY cell, 15% blank transparent border TOP AND BOTTOM. No particle effects or slashes or bolts whatsoever. No magical glow clouds. Short weapon posing entirely inside central 60% of cell. Twelve SMALL sprites with abundant empty space; NEVER extend any sprite across invisible cell boundary. Death sprites also fit within central 60% width.
